# Tequila Fest Cleveland

> Cleveland's biggest annual tequila festival — 50+ premium tequila brands, authentic tacos, live music, and VIP experiences.

## Event Information

- **Event:** Tequila Fest Cleveland 2026
- **Date:** Saturday, July 25, 2026
- **Event Hours:** 3:00 PM – 9:00 PM
- **Tequila Sampling Hours:** 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM
- **Venue:** Cuyahoga County Fairgrounds, 19201 E Bagley Rd, Berea, OH 44017
- **Tickets:** https://tequilafestusa.com/events/tequila-fest-cleveland-2026
- **Presenting Sponsor:** Código 1530

## What to Expect

Tequila Fest Cleveland is an annual celebration of tequila culture in northeast Ohio. Attendees 21+ can:

- Sample 50+ premium tequila brands (blanco, reposado, añejo, extra añejo, and mezcal)
- Enjoy authentic tacos and Mexican-inspired food
- Dance to live music from DJ Fusemania (3–6 PM) and Apostle Jones Band (6:30–9 PM)
- Upgrade to VIP for early access, exclusive tequila pours, and premium amenities

## Admission Options

- General Admission (includes tequila sampling 4–8 PM)
- VIP Experience (early entry, premium tequila brands, dedicated lounge)
- Designated Driver tickets available

## Location

Cuyahoga County Fairgrounds
19201 E Bagley Rd
Berea, OH 44017
(Near Cleveland, Ohio — approximately 15 miles southwest of downtown)
